description: constraints.npm: Renovate regenerates package-lock.json with `npm install --package-lock-only`, which npm 12 breaks with EALLOWREMOTE for any package that bundles its own dependencies, here @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi (npm/cli#9800, unfixed). npm 11 does the same job correctly. Drop the constraint once that issue is fixed.

packageRules.description: Mend's shared Renovate gets rate-limited by Maven Central ("Maven Central rate limiting detected despite Redis caching", and the "Release interceptor failed" that follows from the same 429s). Google's mirror serves the same artifacts and metadata without Sonatype's per-user limits. deps.edn goes through the `clojure` datasource, not `maven`, which is why matching only `maven` did nothing. Clojars stays first, since most Clojure libraries live there.
Same as nixconfig: routine action updates merge themselves.
Every deps.edn bump needs deps-lock.json regenerated, which CI does on the PR branch. One PR for all of them means one regeneration instead of a dozen racing each other.
The browser test tooling moves together and never ships to players.
The LiveKit server images in both compose files, and the client SDK, are tested against each other. Bump them in one PR and test voice before merging.
